02:41 PM

Yes, it can be handled differently. A damaged item is not treated like a standard satisfaction return.

If the product itself arrived damaged, it is handled as an after-sales issue, and clear photos of the package and the item are usually needed for review. If only the packaging is damaged but the product works properly, it is generally not treated as a return issue.

A normal return is for a product you simply do not want to keep under the standard return policy.
